selection.rule: Require zero starvation, zero overheat, and at least the reference cycle count. Minimize queries, then prefer higher mean charge, then more cycles. On a complete tie keep the existing strict reference before comparing variant ids.
selection.validationDescription: Longer validation in the same periodic world; this is not a held-out world.
